stylePrompt: Use the declared styleFamily for each item and choose subjects from people, communities, animals, plants, landscapes, weather, tools, vehicles, buildings and everyday objects according to the scene. Keep one coherent style inside each image while varying styles across the batch. Shared constraints: mature learner-facing art direction, landscape 3:2 composition, a clear focal action or relationship, no in-image teaching text, and no live-action or realistic-human impression. When people appear, every readable foreground or midground face must have clearly rendered natural eyes, a nose, a mouth and a scene-appropriate expression. Never use blank oval faces, featureless masks, mannequin heads or shadows that erase the facial features. Vary age, skin tone, facial structure, body type, hairstyle, clothing, ability and occupation naturally. No realistic skin pores, photographic faces, stock-photo staging, logos, watermarks, readable interfaces, chibi proportions or glossy toy rendering.

items.sentenceEn: Repeated tests confirmed the validity of the method.
items.sentenceZh: 重复试验证实了这种方法的有效性。
items.scene: Chinese school science lab, adult researcher repeats a simple water-filter experiment at three matching stations, each produces clear water from cloudy input. Matching repeatable results support method validity; no numbers, labels or readable charts.
items.altText: 三个相同过滤试验都得到清水，支持方法有效。

items.sentenceEn: The bizarre sculpture looked like a teapot with wings.
items.sentenceZh: 这座古怪的雕塑像一把长着翅膀的茶壶。
items.scene: A whimsical non-famous art sculpture of a ceramic teapot with two mismatched sculptural wings displayed on gallery pedestal, clearly intentionally strange artwork rather than living creature. No words or logos.
items.altText: 展台上的古怪雕塑是一把带翅膀的茶壶。

items.sentenceEn: The pond supports a rich ecosystem.
items.sentenceZh: 池塘支持着丰富的生态系统。
items.scene: Chinese wetland pond cutaway with connected living habitats: reeds, water lilies, fish underwater, frog at bank, insects and heron above, decomposing leaves below. Clear ecological coexistence, no crowded impossible species or labels.
items.altText: 湿地池塘中，植物、鱼、蛙、昆虫与水鸟共同生活。

items.sentenceEn: The small cut began to bleed.
items.sentenceZh: 小伤口开始流血。
items.scene: Close illustrated adult hand with one tiny superficial fingertip cut and a small red drop, other hand holds clean gauze ready to cover it. Non-graphic, no sharp object or injury method, no medical instruction text.
items.altText: 指尖小伤口有一滴血，另一只手拿着干净纱布。

items.sentenceEn: Visitors strictly followed the marked path.
items.sentenceZh: 游客严格沿指定小径行走。
items.scene: Nature reserve visitors stay entirely on a clearly bounded boardwalk while fragile plants grow outside it; ranger observes calmly. Every person within walkway boundaries, no footprints among plants or written signs.
items.altText: 保护区游客都走在木栈道内，避开两侧脆弱植被。

items.sentenceEn: She wrote a blog about her garden.
items.sentenceZh: 她写了一篇关于自己花园的博客。
items.scene: Adult at laptop in Chinese courtyard garden composes a blog-like web page represented by garden photo thumbnails and gray non-readable content blocks. Same distinctive raised garden bed visible outdoors and in thumbnails, no readable text or logos.
items.altText: 女子在电脑上整理花园照片与博客页面，窗外是同一花园。

items.sentenceEn: Only a partial view of the moon was visible.
items.sentenceZh: 只能看到月亮的一部分。
items.scene: Night sky, one broad cloud covers part of full round moon leaving clearly only a portion visible; translucent subtle outline behind cloud indicates occlusion rather than lunar crescent phase. No words, numbers or duplicate moons.
items.altText: 云层遮住圆月的一部分，只露出局部月面。

items.sentenceEn: The booking reserved a room for the family.
items.sentenceZh: 这次预订为一家人保留了房间。
items.scene: Chinese family-run guesthouse reception, clerk confirms a family’s advance reservation using a text-free room thumbnail on tablet and offers matching room key, luggage beside family. No readable register, digits or logos.
items.altText: 民宿前台确认一家人的房间预订，并递出钥匙。

items.sentenceEn: He straightened the collar of his shirt.
items.sentenceZh: 他整理了衬衫衣领。
items.scene: Close medium view of adult man adjusting both sides of a clearly folded shirt collar at his neck, tactile fabric weave and complete face visible. No animal collar or brand text.
items.altText: 男子用双手整理脖颈处的衬衫衣领。

items.sentenceEn: She felt bored during the long wait.
items.sentenceZh: 漫长等待让她感到无聊。
items.scene: Adult woman in a quiet waiting room rests chin on palm, looks listlessly at an empty doorway, closed magazine nearby. Clearly bored rather than distressed or ill, complete facial features, no numbers or text.
items.altText: 候室里的女子托着下巴，漫长等待中神情无聊。

items.sentenceEn: A weed grew between the paving stones.
items.sentenceZh: 一株杂草从铺路石缝里长出来。
items.scene: Close view of one vigorous dandelion weed rooted in a narrow crack between stone pavers, serrated leaves and small yellow bloom, not a planted flower bed. No people or writing.
items.altText: 一株蒲公英杂草从铺路石缝中生长。

items.meaningZh: 绑定的；必然的；跳跃；界限
items.sentenceEn: The papers were bound together with string.
items.sentenceZh: 这些纸用绳子绑在一起。
items.scene: A stack of blank archival papers firmly tied together by visible cotton string crossing and knot, adult hands finish tying it. Binding relation clear, no handcuffs, readable documents or text.
items.altText: 一叠空白纸张被交叉的棉绳与绳结绑在一起。

items.sentenceEn: The inspection checked compliance with safety rules.
items.sentenceZh: 检查核查了安全规则的遵守情况。
items.scene: Chinese woodworking workshop safety inspector checks workers using eye protection, machine guards and clear walking lanes against a text-free pictorial safety checklist. Safe compliance shown in observed conditions, no digits or readable words.
items.altText: 检查员核对护目镜、机器防护罩与通道是否符合安全要求。

items.sentenceEn: The breakdown stopped the water pump.
items.sentenceZh: 故障使水泵停止工作。
items.scene: Two-panel same garden irrigation pump: initially water flows through hose, then pump stopped with damaged drive belt shown in a simple cutaway and empty hose flow; technician begins assessment. No live electricity, injury, writing or technical repair instructions.
items.altText: 水泵传动带损坏后停止供水，技术人员查看故障。

items.sentenceEn: A streak of sunlight crossed the floor.
items.sentenceZh: 一条阳光横过地板。
items.scene: Chinese home interior, narrow bright elongated streak of sunlight enters a gap between curtains and stretches diagonally over dark wooden floor. One clear light band, no people, lettering or multiple beams.
items.altText: 窗帘缝隙射入一条阳光，斜斜横过木地板。

items.sentenceEn: The new filter was a breakthrough in clean-water research.
items.sentenceZh: 新过滤器是净水研究的一项突破。
items.scene: Research team at bench celebrates quietly as innovative filter produces clear water after earlier unsuccessful cloudy-water samples. Same test setup links failed trials to a successful meaningful advance. No miracle claims, brands, readable graphs or words.
items.altText: 研究团队经历多次失败后，新过滤器终于得到清水。

items.sentenceEn: The supposedly empty house still had a light on.
items.sentenceZh: 据说空着的房子里仍亮着灯。
items.scene: Two adults outside an allegedly empty house exchange uncertain gestures; a warm lit upper window contradicts expectation. No resident visible so occupancy remains unverified, no ghost, supernatural proof, speech bubbles or text.
items.altText: 两人疑惑地看着据说空置的房子，楼上窗户却亮着灯。

items.sentenceEn: The added shelf gave us more storage space.
items.sentenceZh: 新增的搁板给了我们更多储物空间。
items.scene: Two-panel same pantry cabinet, initially one shelf with cramped items, later an additional matching shelf neatly holds more jars. Added shelf visually distinctive but same cabinet, no labels or numbers.
items.altText: 同一储物柜加装一层搁板后，罐子摆放空间增加。

items.sentenceEn: This breed of dog has a thick curly coat.
items.sentenceZh: 这个品种的狗有浓密卷曲的被毛。
items.scene: Two healthy poodles with clearly recognizable curly coats, slender muzzles and natural proportions relaxing beside an adult caretaker. Breed shared physical traits visible, no show trophies, breeding procedure, labels or words.
items.altText: 两只贵宾犬有相似的浓密卷毛与细长口鼻。

items.sentenceEn: Broadband connected the rural library to the internet.
items.sentenceZh: 宽带把乡村图书馆连接到互联网。
items.scene: Chinese rural library, several computers share a clear illustrated connection from broadband router, adult readers use image-only educational resources. A broad continuous data channel with many geometric packets suggests high-capacity connection, no readable code, numbers or logos.
items.altText: 乡村图书馆的多台电脑通过宽带路由器访问网络学习资料。
